description: An animated shopping centre with polished floors, glass shopfronts and bright ceiling lights. A woman in a gold dress walks hand in hand with a very large, heavily built man in a white T-shirt and white shorts. She spots a gold dress on a mannequin in a lit shop window, spins round and pulls him towards it. Her face fills the screen, beaming with excitement; then his face fills the screen, eyebrows raised and mouth open in dismay. In the last shot she strides out of the shop holding a fan of pink and white bags while he trudges behind her with both hands full of shopping bags.

en.question: What is the woman pointing at?

de.answer: Sie zeigt auf die Schaufensterpuppe im Einkaufszentrum.
de.question: Worauf zeigt die Frau?

es.answer: Está señalando el maniquí del centro comercial.
es.question: ¿Qué está señalando la mujer?

fr.answer: Elle montre du doigt le mannequin dans le centre commercial.
